Follows Claude Code 2.1.312: the spinner line now shows the effort level in force, the way Claude Code's own spinner does.

- The `●·· Running…  2m 29s` line ends with the effort the model is working at (`· high`, or `· effort 2048` for a number). A model without effort shows none
- An `/effort` change made while Claude works shows from your next message, which is when the model takes it up, matching Claude Code's `may wait for your next message` note. Subagent steps don't change it

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
